name: Estrella Tealight Lantern
description: A delicate tabletop lantern with capiz shell panels that glow warm amber when lit. Perfect for intimate dining or bedside ambiance.

name: Aria Hanging Lantern
description: A graceful hanging lantern hand-strung with translucent capiz shells. Creates soft, dappled light ideal for entryways or covered patios.

name: Luma Floor Lantern
description: A striking floor piece with layered capiz shells that cast rich amber patterns across any room. Makes a statement beside reading chairs or in living spaces.

name: Solene Pendant
description: An elegant pendant light with overlapping capiz panels. Softens any room with a warm, diffused glow that shifts gently with the air.

name: Mira Table Lamp
description: A refined table lamp with a hand-assembled capiz shade. Its gentle light adds warmth to bedrooms, studies, and side tables alike.

name: Aurelia Chandelier
description: A grand capiz chandelier that transforms any ceiling into a luminous focal point. Hundreds of shells, hand-assembled one by one.

name: Parol Capiz Star
description: A traditional Filipino parol reimagined in hand-polished capiz shells. A radiant symbol of the season — beautiful displayed year-round.

name: Noche Ornament Set
description: Six delicate capiz ornaments that shimmer on any tree. Each piece is hand-cut and hand-polished by Filipino artisans from the Visayas.

name: Belen Tabletop
description: A nativity scene rendered entirely in capiz shell. A timeless centerpiece that glows softly by candlelight or beneath a warm lamp.
